actions: CALL 'GLC020' USING WS-ﾎｳｺｳ WS-ｷﾞｮｳﾑﾋﾂﾞｹ WS-ｷﾞｮｳﾑﾋﾂﾞｹ-ﾜﾚｷ WS-ﾍﾝｶﾝｹｯｶ

rules.sentence: When `WS-ﾍﾝｶﾝｹｯｶ` is not 0, it accepts `WS-ｺﾏﾝﾄﾞｷﾞｮｳ` from its command line, sets `WS-ｷﾞｮｳﾑﾋﾂﾞｹ` to `WS-ｺﾏﾝﾄﾞｷﾞｮｳ(1:8)`, calls `GLC020`, displays `'GLD080 日付不正: '` `WS-ｺﾏﾝﾄﾞｷﾞｮｳ(1:8)`, sets `RETURN-CODE` to 8, and stops the run.

When `WS-ﾍﾝｶﾝｹｯｶ` is 0 and `WS-GLJRNL-ST` is neither `'00'` nor `'05'` (not `WS-GLJRNL-OK`), it accepts `WS-ｺﾏﾝﾄﾞｷﾞｮｳ` from its command line, sets `WS-ｷﾞｮｳﾑﾋﾂﾞｹ` to `WS-ｺﾏﾝﾄﾞｷﾞｮｳ(1:8)`, calls `GLC020`, sets `WS-ｼｭｳｹｲ-TBL` to zero, opens `GLJRNL-F` for input, opens `REPORT-F` for output, sets `WS-ｴﾗｰﾌｧｲﾙ` to `'GLJRNL'`, sets `WS-ｴﾗｰｽﾃｰﾀｽ` to `WS-GLJRNL-ST`, and performs `ｲｼﾞｮｳ-RTN`.

When `WS-ﾍﾝｶﾝｹｯｶ` is 0; `WS-GLJRNL-ST` is `'00'` or `'05'` (`WS-GLJRNL-OK`); and `WS-REPORT-ST` is not `'00'` (not `WS-REPORT-OK`), it accepts `WS-ｺﾏﾝﾄﾞｷﾞｮｳ` from its command line, sets `WS-ｷﾞｮｳﾑﾋﾂﾞｹ` to `WS-ｺﾏﾝﾄﾞｷﾞｮｳ(1:8)`, calls `GLC020`, sets `WS-ｼｭｳｹｲ-TBL` to zero, opens `GLJRNL-F` for input, opens `REPORT-F` for output, sets `WS-ｴﾗｰﾌｧｲﾙ` to `'GLD080R'`, sets `WS-ｴﾗｰｽﾃｰﾀｽ` to `WS-REPORT-ST`, and performs `ｲｼﾞｮｳ-RTN`.

When `WS-ﾍﾝｶﾝｹｯｶ` is 0; `WS-GLJRNL-ST` is `'00'` or `'05'` (`WS-GLJRNL-OK`); and `WS-REPORT-ST` is `'00'` (`WS-REPORT-OK`), it accepts `WS-ｺﾏﾝﾄﾞｷﾞｮｳ` from its command line, sets `WS-ｷﾞｮｳﾑﾋﾂﾞｹ` to `WS-ｺﾏﾝﾄﾞｷﾞｮｳ(1:8)`, calls `GLC020`, sets `WS-ｼｭｳｹｲ-TBL` to zero, opens `GLJRNL-F` for input, opens `REPORT-F` for output, and performs `GLJRNL-ﾖﾐｺﾐ-RTN`.

When `WS-GLJRNL-ST` is neither `'00'` nor `'05'` (not `WS-GLJRNL-OK`) and `WS-GLJRNL-ST` is not `'10'` (not `WS-GLJRNL-ｵﾜﾘ`), it reads `GLJRNL-F`, sets `WS-ｴﾗｰﾌｧｲﾙ` to `'GLJRNL'`, sets `WS-ｴﾗｰｽﾃｰﾀｽ` to `WS-GLJRNL-ST`, and performs `ｲｼﾞｮｳ-RTN`.
When `WS-GLJRNL-ST` is `'00'` or `'05'` (`WS-GLJRNL-OK`) or `WS-GLJRNL-ST` is `'10'` (`WS-GLJRNL-ｵﾜﾘ`), it reads `GLJRNL-F`.

conditions: JR-ｱｲﾃｶﾓｸ IS NOT NUMERIC OR JR-ｱｲﾃｶﾓｸ = 0

rules.sentence: When `JR-ｱｲﾃｶﾓｸ` is not numeric or `JR-ｱｲﾃｶﾓｸ` is 0, it adds 1 to `WS-ｼﾜｹｹﾝｽｳ`, adds 1 to `WS-ﾌｾｲｹﾝｽｳ`, sets `WS-ﾌｯｷｺｰﾄﾞ` to 4, and performs `GLJRNL-ﾖﾐｺﾐ-RTN`.

When `JR-ｱｲﾃｶﾓｸ` is numeric and `JR-ｱｲﾃｶﾓｸ` is not 0; and `JR-ﾀｲｼｬｸ` is `'D'` (`JR-ｶﾘｶﾀ`), it adds 1 to `WS-ｼﾜｹｹﾝｽｳ`, sets `WS-ｷﾁｮｳ-ｶﾓｸ` to `JR-ｶﾝｼﾞｮｳｶﾓｸ`, sets `WS-ｷﾁｮｳ-ｶﾞﾜ` to `JR-ﾀｲｼｬｸ`, performs `ｷﾁｮｳ-RTN`, sets `WS-ｷﾁｮｳ-ｶﾓｸ` to `JR-ｱｲﾃｶﾓｸ`, sets `WS-ｷﾁｮｳ-ｶﾞﾜ` to `'C'`, performs `ｷﾁｮｳ-RTN`, and performs `GLJRNL-ﾖﾐｺﾐ-RTN`.

When `JR-ｱｲﾃｶﾓｸ` is numeric and `JR-ｱｲﾃｶﾓｸ` is not 0; and `JR-ﾀｲｼｬｸ` is not `'D'` (not `JR-ｶﾘｶﾀ`), it adds 1 to `WS-ｼﾜｹｹﾝｽｳ`, sets `WS-ｷﾁｮｳ-ｶﾓｸ` to `JR-ｶﾝｼﾞｮｳｶﾓｸ`, sets `WS-ｷﾁｮｳ-ｶﾞﾜ` to `JR-ﾀｲｼｬｸ`, performs `ｷﾁｮｳ-RTN`, sets `WS-ｷﾁｮｳ-ｶﾓｸ` to `JR-ｱｲﾃｶﾓｸ`, sets `WS-ｷﾁｮｳ-ｶﾞﾜ` to `'D'`, performs `ｷﾁｮｳ-RTN`, and performs `GLJRNL-ﾖﾐｺﾐ-RTN`.

When `WS-ｶﾓｸ-ｺｰﾄﾞ(WS-ｶﾓｸ-IX)` is `WS-ｷﾁｮｳ-ｶﾓｸ` and `WS-ｷﾁｮｳ-ｶﾞﾜ` is `'D'` (`WS-ｷﾁｮｳ-ｶﾘｶﾀ`), it sets `WS-ｶﾓｸ-IX` to 1; searches `WS-ｶﾓｸ`; runs `SET WS-N TO WS-ｶﾓｸ-IX`; and adds `JR-ｷﾝｶﾞｸ` to `WS-ｶﾘｶﾀ(WS-N)` and `WS-ｶﾘｶﾀｺﾞｳｹｲ`.

When `WS-ｶﾓｸ-ｺｰﾄﾞ(WS-ｶﾓｸ-IX)` is `WS-ｷﾁｮｳ-ｶﾓｸ` and `WS-ｷﾁｮｳ-ｶﾞﾜ` is not `'D'` (not `WS-ｷﾁｮｳ-ｶﾘｶﾀ`), it sets `WS-ｶﾓｸ-IX` to 1; searches `WS-ｶﾓｸ`; runs `SET WS-N TO WS-ｶﾓｸ-IX`; and adds `JR-ｷﾝｶﾞｸ` to `WS-ｶｼｶﾀ(WS-N)` and `WS-ｶｼｶﾀｺﾞｳｹｲ`.
When `WS-ｶﾓｸ-ｺｰﾄﾞ(WS-ｶﾓｸ-IX)` is not `WS-ｷﾁｮｳ-ｶﾓｸ`, it sets `WS-ｶﾓｸ-IX` to 1, searches `WS-ｶﾓｸ`, adds 1 to `WS-ﾌｾｲｹﾝｽｳ`, and sets `WS-ﾌｯｷｺｰﾄﾞ` to 4.

tables.loop: PERFORM VARYING WS-N FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL WS-N > 14

rules.sentence: When `WS-ｶﾘｶﾀ(WS-N)` is more than 0 or `WS-ｶｼｶﾀ(WS-N)` is more than 0, it sets `WS-ﾒｲｻｲ-ｺｰﾄﾞ` to `WS-ｶﾓｸ-ｺｰﾄﾞ(WS-N)`, sets `WS-ﾒｲｻｲ-ﾒｲ` to `WS-ｶﾓｸ-ﾒｲ(WS-N)`, sets `WS-ﾒｲｻｲ-ｶﾘｶﾀ` to `WS-ｶﾘｶﾀ(WS-N)`, sets `WS-ﾒｲｻｲ-ｶｼｶﾀ` to `WS-ｶｼｶﾀ(WS-N)`, and writes `ﾎｳｺｸ-ｷﾞｮｳ` from `WS-ﾒｲｻｲ-ｷﾞｮｳ`.
When `WS-ｶﾘｶﾀ(WS-N)` is at most 0 and `WS-ｶｼｶﾀ(WS-N)` is at most 0, it does nothing more.
